components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is combined with the last name to form the owner's
            'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred over this flat value. On a successful create the returned
            'address' is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on create (surrounding
            whitespace trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased and common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized on create the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept when present,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped and the result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The
            E.164 value (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. The value is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be exactly
            4 digits and valid for the owner's city per a fixed region-to-range
            table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no
            known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and
            returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-16'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it is stored and used to derive the owner's ageBand
            relative to their registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even if
            another owner already has the same last name and address (i.e. the
            two share a household). Ignored otherwise and never stored.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical link to this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' from the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, or just the last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last names,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot (e.g. 'J.S.').
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member identifier assigned on create,
                formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the canonical region, the
                2-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate, the 8 upper-case hex
                characters of the SHA-256 digest of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn
                check digit computed over the digits of <REGION><FY><HASH8>
                (e.g. 'NSW263A7F9C2E5').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263A7F9C2E5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, shared identifier for the owner's household (owners with
                the same last name at the same address). It is derived
                deterministically from the normalized last name and address, so
                every owner in the same household is assigned the same value,
                formatted 'HH-<12 upper-case hex chars>' (e.g. 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08').
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, consolidating the
                identity-bearing fields into a single value formatted
                '<telephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>' (e.g.
                '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'). Duplicate detection is expressed
                solely through this key.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3A7F9C2E1B08'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners at the time of creation that share
                this owner's first and last name, compared case-insensitively
                (i.e. excluding this owner itself).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate falls in, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on
                1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so
                1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from their own fields.
                Starts at 0; adds 2 when an email is present; adds 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0; adds 2 for a household of 3 or more; adds 3
                for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 5
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level derived from their
                membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or
                more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), absent
                when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time it was created. True once
                that day's owner count exceeds 80, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                at the time it was created, approaching the hard capacity limit
                of 50. True when the city's owner count was in that range,
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, at the time it was created, was a soft match
                for an existing owner: not a hard duplicate, but sharing an
                existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a
                different telephone. True when such a match existed, otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner softly matched on
                creation (same last name and postcode, different telephone).
                Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Whether this owner is flagged for review. True when any of the
                following holds at the time it was created: the owner is a
                possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (its second-level label matches a
                known disposable provider, e.g. 'mailinator.net'), or the owner's
                city was over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is true).
                Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from their birthDate relative to
                their registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to
                64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment as '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3
                or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true and retains the record,
                and a deleted owner is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What I implemented

The spec: return `riskFlag` true when **any** of — owner is a possible duplicate, email domain is disposable-adjacent, or city is over its soft capacity — otherwise false.

Three changes, following the existing derived-field pattern:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `riskFlag` boolean (read-only) property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

2. **`src/main/java/.../util/RiskFlags.java`** (new) — the logic:
   - **possible duplicate** → `possibleDuplicate == true` (the soft-match flag already stored on create).
   - **city over soft capacity** → `capacityWarning == true` (already stored; true when the city held 40–49 owners, i.e. past the soft threshold of 40, the hard cap of 50 being rejected outright).
   - **disposable-adjacent email** → the email's second-level domain label matches a known disposable provider (`mailinator`, `tempmail`, `guerrillamail`) on a *different* full domain, e.g. `mailinator.net` — distinct from the hard blocklist (`mailinator.com` etc.), which is rejected at create time.

3. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — a `@Mapping` expression computing `riskFlag` from the owner's stored `possibleDuplicate`, `capacityWarning`, and `email`, so it's consistent on both the create response and later GETs.

The remaining 2 failures — `Cp23Tests` and `Cp39Tests`, both asserting `membershipLevel` 3 but getting 2 — are **pre-existing and unrelated to this task**. Fixing them would mean altering the membership-capping feature, which is outside this change's scope and risks other checkpoints.

So the suite is in exactly the same state as before, plus the new `riskFlag` checkpoint now passing. I did not touch the membership logic to avoid masking or entangling that separate, pre-existing conflict — let me know if you'd like me to dig into those two as well.
